scope: Private operator setup provenance, never diagnostic input
authorization: Owner reviewed the previous airborne generator checkpoint and requested the next stage. Standing native setup handover; leak notification preceded qualification/injection. No D snapshot approval.
launch: Fresh native ground startup because no FlightGear or systems-panel process/listener existed at initial inspection. Native takeoff/climb; no instantaneous cruise restore or computed-state/gauge overwrite.
capture_limits: Supporting exact helper/log snapshots, not a complete machine/input recorder. No native HTTP screenshot or Windows capture attempted this stage. Startup probe initially requested a nonexistent dictionary key and failed read-only before readiness was rechecked; partial startup snapshot is preserved.
operator_parameters: 160kt experimental rotation trigger and -0.18 normalized elevator input are original simulator setup choices, not aircraft takeoff performance values/procedures. Selected indicated10000ft differs from observed position altitude near10171ft.
checkpoint_state: Master/clock paused after verified recovery; gen2/leak flags false; gear actuator readbacks0; AP1/autothrust engaged and effective autothrust active.
